name: FND_NTF_RECIPIENT_CHNL
description: Entity for managing user specific values for the channel specific properties.

columns.name: RECIPIENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the fnd_ntf_recipient table.

columns.name: APP_MODULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the fnd_ntf_application_module table.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Alias or any unique identifier for the recipient within the ApplicationModule.

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE
columns.description: The name for the channel as registered in fnd_ntf_channel table.

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: Used as pause/resume or enable/disable switch for the channel scoped to the recepient within the applicationModule scope.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: The users unique and personal delivery address in this channel.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
